research:
I could not open the Yahoo Finance page itself, so the October 16 close is not confirmed from the resolution source. Two secondary sources put it at about 2,720, down roughly 1.7% on the day. The index is about 11% below its August record and in a technical correction, after a hot inflation report and fears of more Fed rate hikes. Nothing has settled the question yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- The resolution source is the daily close of ^RUT on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-23, a Friday and a normal trading day. My tool's connection to Yahoo Finance and Investing.com was refused, so I could not read either page directly. [Yahoo ^RUT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5ERUT/)
- 2026-10-16: TheStreet reports a close of 2,719.57 (-1.72%). [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-oct-16-2026)
- 2026-10-16: Investing.com's table (seen through search results) shows a close of 2,721.37, an open of 2,768.92, a high of 2,771.73, a low of 2,716.23 and a change of -1.66%. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/indices/smallcap-2000-historical-data)
- 2026-10-16: An AP/ABC wire was summarized as saying the index fell 85.61 points, about 3%. That does not match the other two sources. [ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Business/wireStory/major-us-stock-indexes-fared-friday-10162026-137331951)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the outcome. The latest close of about 2,720 sits inside the question's range of 2,450 to 3,000. There are five trading days left (Oct 19-23).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-16: The Nasdaq fell 2.1%, the S&P 500 fell 1.1% to 7,659.44 and the Dow fell 0.34%. Coverage blamed worries about AI valuations and how the AI boom is financed, plus higher Treasury yields after the hot CPI. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 posted weekly losses; the Dow posted a weekly gain. [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-oct-16-2026), [Yahoo/Investopedia](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/markets-news-oct-16-2026-103800633.html)
- 2026-10-15: The index rebounded 1.38% to 2,767.27 and was up 10.33% for the year. [Tapeboard](https://tapeboard.com/blog/market-pulse-2026-10-15)
- 2026-10-14: The index fell 1.93% to 2,729.53 and entered a correction (more than 10% below its peak), its first since March. About five stocks fell for every one that rose. Core CPI rose 0.3% for the month and 2.6% from a year earlier, both above forecasts, and traders priced in more rate hikes. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-14/russell-2000-sinks-11-from-peak-hits-correction-as-rates-rise), [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-oct-14-2026)
- Before CPI: StoneX noted the index had broken below its 200-day moving average, and FXEmpire wrote about a possible retest of 2,500. [StoneX](https://www.stonex.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/russell-2000-breaks-200-day-average-as-cpi-risk-looms/), [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/russell-2000-forecast-small-cap-pullback-eyes-2500-retest-as-fed-cut-holds-firm-1636865)
- 2026-09-16: A search summary said the Fed raised rates at this meeting, its first hike since 2023. The FXEmpire headline says "Fed cut holds firm," which conflicts with that, so I could not confirm what the Fed did.

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-08-14: The record close was 3,068.42 (intraday high 3,069.71). The current level is about 11% below it. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russell_2000_Index)
- 2026-10-02: The IWM ETF closed at 281.52, against a peak close of 305.09 on August 14. [ChartRow](https://chartrow.com/russell-2000/year-by-year)
- Recent daily swings have been large: -1.93%, +1.38% and -1.72% on October 14, 15 and 16.
- Typical variation (my general knowledge, not from a source): the Russell 2000 usually moves about 2.5-3% in a week (one standard deviation), and more when volatility is high, as now. From about 2,720, a ±3% move gives roughly 2,640-2,800. A ±6% move gives roughly 2,555-2,885. The question's range covers about -10% to +10%.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs daily "RUT Up or Down" markets. The October 15 one resolved "Up." I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the October 23 level or that week. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/rut-up-or-down-on-october-15-2026)
- I found no expert point forecasts for October 23, apart from FXEmpire's technical talk of a 2,500 retest.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (Oct 19-23)
- No CPI, jobs report or Fed decision is scheduled that week. The main releases are September housing starts (forecast 1.30M), weekly jobless claims (forecast 200K) and the October flash S&P Global PMIs (services forecast 58.0, manufacturing 55.5). Comments from Fed officials could matter, given the fears of further hikes. [Investing.com preview](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-economic-calendar-preview-key-releases-for-the-week-of-oct-1923-2026-93CH-4958178), [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/newsquawk-weekly-economic-calendar---19th-23rd-october-2026)
- Earnings: 212 companies worth $2 billion or more report, including Meta, Tesla, Netflix and Procter & Gamble, according to StockTitan. That timing looks early for some of these names, so it is worth checking. These results matter for the AI-valuation worries. [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/earnings-calendar-week-of-october-19-2026)
- The next Fed decision and the Q3 GDP estimate are on October 28-29, after the resolution date, but expectations for them could move rate-sensitive small caps beforehand. [Substack calendar](https://letterstoayounginvestor.substack.com/p/weekly-economic-calendar-october-a93)
